snippet.title: [ Gentleman's Proposal ] Teaser video revealed!
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD:
https://gentlemansproposal.page.link/Download

Can’t find the right groom? You're headed for an arranged marriage with a rich old man!
But suddenly, four irresistible suitors appear in your life...
Could one of them be your way out?

"What if we just pretend to be in love?"

You’ve entered high society to escape your political marriage, but things get a lot more heated than expected!

"If someone sees us like this, it could ruin you."

Set in the glamorous 19th-century English social scene, where romance and passion are never far away, you must navigate thrilling encounters as a strong, bold young woman. 
Can you find your 'perfect proposal' before time runs out?
#otomegame
